purpose_text.para: Describes the features provided by the AArch32 Advanced SIMD and floating-point implementation.
Must be interpreted with MVFR0 and MVFR1.
For general information about the interpretation of the ID registers see 'Principles of the ID scheme for fields in ID registers'.

configuration_text.para: Implemented only if the implementation includes Advanced SIMD and floating-point instructions.

field_description.para: Indicates whether the floating-point implementation provides support for miscellaneous VFP features.
In Armv8, the permitted values are 0b0000 and 0b0100.

field_value_description.para: Not implemented, or no support for miscellaneous features.
As 0b0001, and Floating-point Conversion to Integer with Directed Rounding modes.
As 0b0010, and Floating-point Round to Integer Floating-point.
As 0b0011, and Floating-point MaxNum and MinNum.

field_description.para: Indicates whether the Advanced SIMD implementation provides support for miscellaneous Advanced SIMD features.
In Armv8, the permitted values are 0b0000 and 0b0011.

field_value_description.para: Not implemented, or no support for miscellaneous features.
Floating-point Conversion to Integer with Directed Rounding modes.
As 0b0001, and Floating-point Round to Integer Floating-point.
As 0b0010, and Floating-point MaxNum and MinNum.

ps.name: VMRS
